description: This header file declares functions and a structure related to managing server connections in the Lighttpd project, including connection cleanup, shutdown procedures, and state management.

methods.name: connections_pool_clear
methods.description: Clears the connection pool for the server, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: connections_free
methods.description: Frees all connection resources related to the server.

methods.name: connection_graceful_shutdown_maint
methods.description: Performs maintenance tasks to gracefully shut down connections.

methods.name: connection_periodic_maint
methods.description: Performs periodic maintenance on server connections, likely invoked at regular intervals.

methods.name: connection_accepted
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a new incoming connection.

methods.name: connection_state_machine
methods.description: Manages the state transitions for a specific connection.
